note: GENERATED by scripts/gen_release_artifact.py from provael.__version__, which hatch also reads as the package version. Do not hand-edit: the point of this file is that no human types the release number. It exists because a consumer that keeps its own copy goes stale the moment a release ships without someone remembering to re-pin it, which is how www.provael.com came to serve v0.39.3 on 14 pages while the tag, the GitHub release and PyPI all said 0.39.4. `tag` is the git tag the release workflow publishes from and `pypi` is the same string, because the workflow publishes from that tag. There is deliberately NO commit sha and NO published_at: this script runs offline and could only guess at them, and an unverifiable field in a trust artifact is worse than a missing one.
